    "Effectively tracks goods arrival times for our medical devices.",

    "Reliable performance with no reported crashes or issues."

  "cons": [
    "The initial setup and learning curve were quite overwhelming.",
    "Limitations in editing multiple lines simultaneously can be frustrating.",
    "The copy/paste function is sometimes unreliable."

  "overall_experience": "This Account Manager found Smartsheet to be a robust tool for managing the tracking of goods arrival times for medical devices. While the initial learning curve was steep, they ultimately found it user-friendly and effective for their specific task. The platform proved reliable, though some minor frustrations arose from limited bulk editing and inconsistent copy/paste functionality."
